```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  // Step 1: Determine per-step offset
  int dRow;
  int dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  // Step 3: check first step
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  // Step 4: initialize collections
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  // Step 5-6: loop
  Position current = startPos;
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break; // boundary
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      // Step e: stop here, place player
      EntityCell targetCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell sourceCell = player.getOwner();
      targetCell.setentity(player);
      sourceCell.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      break;
    }
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        // Dead - restore state
        Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
        dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
        dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
        dead.setMinePosition(next);
        return dead;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      // else empty - proceed
    }
    current = next;
  }
  
  // Step 7: move player from source to current
  EntityCell sourceCell2 = player.getOwner();
  EntityCell targetCell2 = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(current);
  targetCell2.setentity(player);
  sourceCell2.setentity(null);
  
  // Step 8: build Alive
  Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
  return alive;
}
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  int dRow, dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: 
      return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  // Step 3: check first step
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  Position current = startPos;
  Position minePos = null;
  
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break;
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      // Place player on StopCell
      EntityCell stop = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
      stop.setentity(player);
      src.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      return buildAlive(current, startPos, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
    }
    
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell ec = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = ec.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        minePos = next;
        break;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        ec.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        ec.setentity(null);
      }
    }
    current = next;
  }
  
  if (minePos != null)
  {
    // Dead - restore collected gems and lives
    for (Position gp : collectedGems)
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
    }
    for (Position lp : collectedExtraLives)
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
    }
    Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
    dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
    dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
    dead.setMinePosition(minePos);
    return dead;
  }
  
  // Alive - move player to current
  EntityCell target = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(current);
  EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
  target.setentity(player);
  src.setentity(null);
  
  Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
  return alive;
}
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  // Step 1: Determine per-step offset
  int dRow;
  int dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  // Step 3: check first step
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  // Step 4: initialize collections
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  // Step 5-6: loop
  Position current = startPos;
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break; // boundary
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      // Step e: stop here, place player
      EntityCell targetCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell sourceCell = player.getOwner();
      targetCell.setentity(player);
      sourceCell.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      break;
    }
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        // Dead - restore state
        Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
        dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
        dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
        dead.setMinePosition(next);
        return dead;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      // else empty - proceed
    }
    current = next;
  }
  
  // Step 7: move player from source to current
  EntityCell sourceCell2 = player.getOwner();
  EntityCell targetCell2 = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(current);
  targetCell2.setentity(player);
  sourceCell2.setentity(null);
  
  // Step 8: build Alive
  Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
  return alive;
}
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  int dRow, dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: 
      return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  // Step 3: check first step
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  Position current = startPos;
  Position minePos = null;
  
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break;
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      // Place player on StopCell
      EntityCell stop = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
      stop.setentity(player);
      src.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      return buildAlive(current, startPos, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
    }
    
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell ec = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = ec.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        minePos = next;
        break;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        ec.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        ec.setentity(null);
      }
    }
    current = next;
  }
  
  if (minePos != null)
  {
    // Dead - restore collected gems and lives
    for (Position gp : collectedGems)
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
    }
    for (Position lp : collectedExtraLives)
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
    }
    Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
    dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
    dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
    dead.setMinePosition(minePos);
    return dead;
  }
  
  // Alive - move player to current
  EntityCell target = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(current);
  EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
  target.setentity(player);
  src.setentity(null);
  
  Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
  return alive;
}
```

```java
      case RIGHT:
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  int dRow, dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  Position current = startPos;
  boolean stoppedOnStopCell = false;
  
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break;
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      EntityCell stopCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
      stopCell.setentity(player);
      src.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      stoppedOnStopCell = true;
      break;
    }
    
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        // Dead - restore gems/lives and return
        for (Position gp : collectedGems)
        {
          gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
        }
        for (Position lp : collectedExtraLives)
        {
          gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
        }
        Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
        dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
        dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
        dead.setMinePosition(next);
        return dead;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);

  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  // Step 1: Determine per-step offset
  int dRow;
  int dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  // Step 3: check first step
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  // Step 4: initialize collections
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  // Step 5-6: loop
  Position current = startPos;
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break; // boundary
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      // Step e: stop here, place player
      EntityCell targetCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell sourceCell = player.getOwner();
      targetCell.setentity(player);
      sourceCell.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      break;
    }
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        // Dead - restore state
        Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
        dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
        dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
        dead.setMinePosition(next);
        return dead;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        entityCell.setentity(null);
      }
      // else empty - proceed
    }
    current = next;
  }
  
  // Step 7: move player from source to current
  EntityCell sourceCell2 = player.getOwner();
  EntityCell targetCell2 = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(current);
  targetCell2.setentity(player);
  sourceCell2.setentity(null);
  
  // Step 8: build Alive
  Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
  return alive;
}
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  int dRow, dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: 
      return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  // Step 3: check first step
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  Position current = startPos;
  Position minePos = null;
  
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break;
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)
    {
      // Place player on StopCell
      EntityCell stop = (EntityCell) cell;
      EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
      stop.setentity(player);
      src.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      return buildAlive(current, startPos, collectedGems, collectedExtraLives);
    }
    
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell ec = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = ec.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        minePos = next;
        break;
      }
      else if (entity instanceof Gem)
      {
        collectedGems.add(next);
        ec.setentity(null);
      }
      else if (entity instanceof ExtraLife)
      {
        collectedExtraLives.add(next);
        ec.setentity(null);
      }
    }
    current = next;
  }
  
  if (minePos != null)
  {
    // Dead - restore collected gems and lives
    for (Position gp : collectedGems)
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
    }
    for (Position lp : collectedExtraLives)
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
    }
    Dead dead = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createDead();
    dead.setNewPosition(startPos);
    dead.setOrigPosition(startPos);
    dead.setMinePosition(minePos);
    return dead;
  }
  
  // Alive - move player to current
  EntityCell target = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(current);
  EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
  target.setentity(player);
  src.setentity(null);
  
  Alive alive = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createAlive();
  alive.setNewPosition(current);
  alive.setOrigPosition(startPos);
  alive.getCollectedGems().addAll(collectedGems);
  alive.getCollectedExtraLives().addAll(collectedExtraLives);
  return alive;
```

```java
public MoveResult makeMove(final Direction direction)
{
  int dRow, dCol;
  switch (direction)
  {
    case UP: dRow = -1; dCol = 0; break;
    case DOWN: dRow = 1; dCol = 0; break;
    case LEFT: dRow = 0; dCol = -1; break;
    case RIGHT: dRow = 0; dCol = 1; break;
    default: return null;
  }
  
  int numRows = gameBoard.getNumRows();
  int numCols = gameBoard.getNumCols();
  Player player = gameBoard.getPlayer();
  Position startPos = player.getOwner().getPosition();
  
  Position firstPos = startPos.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
  if (firstPos == null || gameBoard.getCell2(firstPos) instanceof Wall)
  {
    Invalid invalid = Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createInvalid();
    invalid.setNewPosition(startPos);
    return invalid;
  }
  
  EList<Position> collectedGems = new BasicEList<Position>();
  EList<Position> collectedExtraLives = new BasicEList<Position>();
  
  Position current = startPos;
  boolean stoppedOnStopCell = false;
  
  while (true)
  {
    Position next = current.offsetByOrNull1(dRow, dCol, numRows, numCols);
    if (next == null) break;
    
    Cell cell = gameBoard.getCell2(next);
    if (cell instanceof Wall) break;
    
    if (cell instanceof StopCell)

      EntityCell src = player.getOwner();
      stopCell.setentity(player);
      src.setentity(null);
      current = next;
      stoppedOnStopCell = true;
      break;
    }
    
    if (cell instanceof EntityCell)
    {
      EntityCell entityCell = (EntityCell) cell;
      Entity entity = entityCell.getEntity();
      if (entity instanceof Mine)
      {
        // Dead - restore gems/lives and return
        for (Position gp : collectedGems)
        {
          gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gp).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
        }
```

   *          and re-placing all collected Gems and ExtraLives back onto the board at their
   *          previously recorded positions. This method only handles board-level state;
   *          counter and life changes are managed by the GameController.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. Assert prevMove is an Alive (only Alive moves are undoable).
   *   2. target = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(prevMove.newPosition) (current player cell).
   *   3. origin = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(prevMove.origPosition).
   *   4. Remove the player from `target` and place it back into `origin`
   *      (using setentity on each, updating the back-references).
   *   5. For each gemPos in prevMove.collectedGems:
   *        cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gemPos); cell.setentity(new Gem()).
   *   6. For each lifePos in prevMove.collectedExtraLives:
   *        cell = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lifePos); cell.setentity(new ExtraLife()).
   * Related Features: GameBoardController.gameBoard
   * Related Classes: Alive, MoveResult, GameBoard, EntityCell, Gem, ExtraLife, Player, Position
   * Input: prevMove : MoveResult - the Alive move result to undo; must be of type Alive
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - prevMove is non-null and is an Alive instance.
   *   - The board state matches the end-state implied by prevMove (player is at newPosition,
   *     collected Gems/ExtraLives are absent from the board).
   * Post-condition:
   *   - Player is back at prevMove.origPosition.
   *   - All previously collected Gems and ExtraLives are restored to their recorded positions.
   *   - Move counters are not modified by this method.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void undoMove(final MoveResult prevMove)
  {
    Alive alive = (Alive) prevMove;

    EntityCell target = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(alive.getNewPosition());
    EntityCell origin = gameBoard.getEntityCell1(alive.getOrigPosition());

    // Step 4: move player from target back to origin
    Player player = (Player) target.getEntity();
    target.setentity(null);
    origin.setentity(player);

    // Step 5: restore collected Gems
    for (Position gemPos : alive.getCollectedGems())
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(gemPos).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createGem());
    }

    // Step 6: restore collected ExtraLives
    for (Position lifePos : alive.getCollectedExtraLives())
    {
      gameBoard.getEntityCell1(lifePos).setentity(Pa21Factory.eINSTANCE.createExtraLife());
    }
  }
